_comment: Fixture for the per-target escape-risk band. Four cases: a well-studied protein target, a multi-copy rRNA target that is downgraded for recessiveness, a target whose only documented escape route is replacement, and a target with no documented mutations at all (unknown, never low). See docs/resistance-risk.md.

caveats.message: the count reflects how much this target has been studied as well as how readily it mutates; CARD does not separate the two
